details:
MARTIAN MAP – Abandoned but Not Forgotten

Project Overview

MARTIAN MAP is an interactive web-based project that explores the remains of human-made equipment left behind during space exploration on Mars and the Moon.

The project highlights abandoned rovers, landers, spacecraft components and other exploration equipment, telling the story of humanity's journey beyond Earth.

Objectives

  • Explore the history of human space exploration.
  • Discover abandoned equipment on Mars and the Moon.
  • Present space-related information through an engaging visual experience.
  • Raise awareness about the legacy of past space missions.

Key Features

  • Cinematic, animated scrolling website.
  • Dark, science-inspired visual design.
  • Exploration-focused content about Mars and the Moon.
  • Interactive and visually engaging presentation.
  • Space exploration information inspired by NASA resources.

Technology

  • HTML
  • CSS
  • JavaScript
  • Web animations

Project Theme: Space Exploration
Tagline: Abandoned but Not Forgotten.
